_note: Applied by videos/shared/narrate-walkthrough.mjs on top of showcase/SCRIPT.md, which is never edited. Two kinds of change: (a) cue times, because SCRIPT.md's timestamps are estimates — record.spec.ts paces itself off real UI state, and every beat from 00:15 on lands EARLIER in this recording than the script predicted, by up to 25s; times below are read off the recording's own transition profile and confirmed against extracted frames. (b) trimmed narration, because the script is written long: at this voice's ~162 wpm the nine cues need 3:07 of speech against a 2:44 recording, and the early beats leave only 8-10s of screen time.

1.text: Someone on a live call needs to know what is true right now, not after it ends. This is Live, the screen VoiceBridge opens on, and the banner says plainly what it will not do.
1.note: trimmed 65w to 35w; the Live screen only holds 10.5s before the sample starts

2.text: Press play. The brief is not redrawn from scratch on every line — the version number only moves forward when the server's own throttle decides a refresh is worth an LLM call, so a burst of turns produces one refresh, not nine. Watch it climb through several real versions as the caller says more: a machine shop, then binder jetting, then a furnace, then titanium and budget. Every claim is grounded, and the sources build up underneath as the call goes on.
2.note: Play sample is pressed at 10.4s, not 15s (frame-verified); trimmed 93w to 79w

3.text: Next to the brief, the transcript, and the session's own numbers: refreshes run, refreshes the throttle skipped, and the last refresh's latency.
3.note: the session-stats card appears at 43.4s, not 60s — 16.5s earlier; only 8s of screen time before End and save, so 65w trimmed to 22w. The mock-vs-real latency aside is dropped; the mock-Knowledge-Box honesty is still carried by cues 5 and 9.

4.text: Ending a session loses nothing — the brief, its sources and how it developed are kept. Conversations lists every call this deployment has listened to, and searching for something the caller actually said finds this one. Opening it shows the same final brief, the full transcript, and every version the brief passed through on the way there, each timestamped and timed.
4.note: End and save happens at 51.3s, not 76s — 24.5s earlier; trimmed 72w to 59w

5.note: Knowledge opens at 75.9s, not 96s — 20s earlier; text unchanged, it fits the 28s window

6.text: Before a prospect is trusted to answer it has to clear this gate: ten questions, run right now, through the same pipeline a real call uses. All ten pass, so the gate opens.
6.note: the golden-set run lands at 104.2s, not 114s; trimmed 64w to 33w. The caveat that this is the only automated gate — none yet for the live brief — does not fit the 10.4s window and is dropped.

7.text: Quality checks all of that in aggregate. And when someone tries an injection, the guard trips before the model sees it — the log keeps the reason, never the text.
7.note: Quality opens at 114.5s, not 127s — 12.4s earlier; trimmed 43w to 29w for the 10.4s window

8.note: the Operator panel opens at 124.8s, not 139s — 14.2s earlier; text unchanged, it fits the 28.5s window across Overview, Listen sessions and the brief history
